title: Boba Fett
section: The Merchandising Art of Star Wars
description: Boba Fett. the fierce bounty hunter, has appeared not only in the STAR WARS trilogy, but as part of the animated DROIDS TV series. So, Kenner Products released a Fett figure in both realistic and "animated" versions. This unattributed illustration (front, collection of Thomas H. Neiheisel) showing R2-D2 and C-3PO hastily departing, appeared on a "Droids" logo card.
